notes: Box chosen in Bayview south of Islais Creek (Hudson, Galvez, Fairfax, Jennings, Menlo, Innes, Martinez, Hunters Point Blvd): a rotated street grid of blocks standing alone in street paper, with diagonal hatching (first residential), cross-hatching (light industrial) and checkerboard (unrestricted), plus curved blocks round Martinez Ave and Hunters Point Blvd. Kept west of the dashed line of Arthur Ave, beyond which the blocks are drawn dashed. Seeds only, except: strokes closing small gaps in block outlines where a corner line stops short (3476,883-3488,891; 3816,1126-3829,1135; 3248,1233-3258,1259 along the line at the crop's west edge). FOR THE OWNER TO RULE ON: (1) A thin curved line (a track, creek or district line, not a block outline) runs from the block corner at about (3985,1530) across the street and into the checkerboard block below at (3980,1576), through it past (3945,1605) and on south to (3960,1724); where it enters it leaves a gap in the block's north line, closed by a stroke (3965,1567-3992,1587), so the unhatched wedge it cuts off (3930-3985, 1560-1645) is block, not street. The whole checkerboard ground both sides of the line is one block as printed. (2) A narrow white strip with rounded ends drawn by two lines inside the checkerboard block, about (4195,1230)-(4268,1175), is left as the fill made it: street (its inside joins the street through a small gap at its north-east end). It may be a narrow way, a rail spur or a strip of another district. Similar double-line bands along block edges near (4040-4060,1280-1320) and (4140-4180,1230-1290) are likewise as the fill made them. (3) The block corner at the west edge (3250-3262,1452-1500) belongs to a block west of the crop and is seeded as its own block. Unseeded islands left as street are street-width figures and lettering ("80", "BO"): 4001,995; 4083,1055; 4170,1116; 3254,1661; 3718,1719. Hatch-hole notches along a few block edges where the outline is broken remain street. Leak closed with a stroke at (3413, 1269) (second look, 2026-11-23). Leak closed with a stroke at (3259, 1182) (second look, 2026-11-23). Three thin outlined strips across the street are read as not part of any block (what they are is not known) and left as street: from the west corner of block 4112,1292 down to the north corner of block 4030,1440 (about 4042-4080 x 1272-1325); along the SE side of block 4112,1292 to the north corner of block 4210,1310 (about 4205-4273 x 1165-1240); and from the south corner of block 4030,1440 across the street (about 3972-3993 x 1520-1562). Each is cut off with strokes on the blocks' own outlines, and blocks 4030,1440 and 4210,1310 got their own seeds (second look, 2026-11-23).
